capstone.title: Capstone Project: AI-Powered School Events Assistant
capstone.text:
An AI-powered chat application that helps parents find school events and programs using natural-language questions. Built as a multi-agent RAG system: a LocalEvents agent retrieves from a Qdrant vector store of school event documents, a WebSearch agent uses Tavily for current online results, and LangGraph orchestrates routing with fallback between them. Also includes Gmail integration for searching a parent's inbox for school communications, RAGAS-based evaluation, and a React + FastAPI stack deployable to Vercel and Railway.
  • Multi-agent orchestration with LangGraph: LocalEvents agent over Qdrant plus Tavily web-search agent, with fallback routing
  • RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter chunking (1000 chars / 200 overlap) that split 65 source documents into 145 chunks, significantly improving retrieval recall
  • Gmail integration via a Model Context Protocol server to search a parent's inbox for school emails
  • FastAPI backend with authentication, school selection, child profiles, interests, bookmarks, and preferences
  • RAGAS evaluation harness with API and WebSocket endpoints for measuring retrieval and generation quality
  • React + Axios frontend, configurable retrieval methods, and local-mode plus Railway/Vercel deployment
